engineering_decision: Do not use full MHD as a default missing-data imputer. Treat all physics output as a separately identified reconstruction hypothesis. It may enter the frozen final model only after causal train-only held-out-gap experiments show better downstream SEP forecast robustness than the best surviving simpler recovery baseline without material calibration degradation.

Freeze eligible modalities and gap durations; then run no-reconstruction/mask-aware, causal forward-fill, train-fit median/simple-statistical and reproducible causal-KNN baselines on identical inner chronological issue identities.
